Hanno Eco-Tourism Association: https://hanno-tourism.jp/hanno-eco/tour/ec-morimana-konchu/

A tour in the satoyama (village farmland) of Hanno City where you will gather wild mountain vegetables traditionally eaten locally, then prepare and enjoy pizza and tempura made from those ingredients.

【Fee】
Adults: ¥4,500 | Students: ¥3,000 | Elementary school and under: ¥2,000
(Includes guide, insurance, materials, food, etc.)

【Capacity】10 people

【Guide】Mori no Field Gakusha (Forest Field Learning Center) staff

【What to bring】
Drink, light snack, change of clothes, hat, clothes you don't mind getting dirty, well-worn shoes (long boots recommended)

【Note】
Mori no Field Gakusha website: https://morinomanabiya168.wixsite.com/website
location: 集合 飯能市中央公園トイレ前（国際興業バス「ＯＨ!!!・天覧山下」下車徒歩1分）
summary: Mountain vegetables from satoyama (village farmland): make and eat pizza & tempura! with insect cuisine
